turns.query: Hong Kong replaced its Air Quality Objectives during 2025. Screen the whole year against the 24-hour PM2.5 objective that applied before the change — a limit of 50 ug/m3 which a station may exceed on up to 35 days in a calendar year — and report how many stations that would put in breach.

Repeat the 2025 station screen with the revised PM2.5 daily objective: 37.5 ug/m3 and eighteen permitted exceedance days. How many stations fail, what explains the change, and can the desk describe this counterfactual full-year screen as a legal breach?
